text: 中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅13日在京会见出席2026中美政党对话的美方代表。
text_en: Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Office of the Central Commission for Foreign Affairs, met in Beijing on the 13th with US representatives attending the 2026 China-US Political Party Dialogue.
